# Isaiah Chapter 46 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 13 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Bel and Nebo fall; idols carried by beasts; God carries Israel; no one like God*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Gods of Babylon:** Bel and Nebo fall; idols carried by beasts; God carries Israel; no one like God. The key message for modern readers: "I have made, and I will bear; I will carry and will save"

*-- PNEUMA*
